# 🕌 Varanasi — 3‑Day Trip
> **Kolkata → Varanasi** · 15 Jan 2027 – 17 Jan 2027 · 1 person · Budget ₹12,000 · Estimated total ₹4,190

## ✨ At a glance
- **Getting there:** Sleeper‑class train 13151 KOAA JAT EXPRESS – ₹395 one‑way
- **Stay:** **Vindh Homestay** – ₹800/night · 2★ · Breakfast included · book on Booking.com
- **Weather:** Cool winter, 8‑15 °C, clear skies
- **Total cost:** ₹4,190 of ₹12,000 budget (₹7,810 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back
- **Go:** Train 13151 KOAA JAT EXPRESS, dep. 02:30 PM Kolkata (Howrah) – arr. 05:30 AM Varanasi, ₹395 p.p.  
- **Return:** Train 13152 JAT KOAA EXPRESS, dep. 09:00 PM Varanasi – arr. 12:00 PM Kolkata, ₹395 p.p.  
- **Why this option:** Cheapest comfortable choice; overnight run saves a night’s lodging and avoids airport hassle.

## 🏨 Where to stay
1. **Vindh Homestay** — ₹800/night · 2★ · Breakfast included · book on Booking.com  
2. **Sah Haveli** — ₹950/night · 2★ · Free Wi‑Fi, rooftop view · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **Shree Guest House** — ₹542/night · 1★ · No‑frills, clean rooms · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day-by-day plan
### Day 1 — Fri, 15 Jan · Journey to Varanasi
- **02:30 PM** — Board train 13151 KOAA JAT EXPRESS at Howrah, Kolkata  
- **08:00 PM** — Settle in sleeper berth, dinner on board (packed snack, ₹50)  
- **11:00 PM** — Light stretch & use onboard washroom, lock luggage  
- 💡 *Tip:* Keep a small bag with toiletries and a change of clothes for the morning arrival.

### Day 2 — Sat, 16 Jan · Arrival, Ghats & Culture
- **05:30 AM** — Arrive Varanasi Junction, take prepaid auto (₹80) to Vindh Homestay, check‑in, freshen up  
- **07:00 AM** — Breakfast at homestay (included) – poha & tea  
- **08:30 AM** — Walk to **Dashashwamedh Ghat** (0.5 km, 5 min) – free, watch morning rituals  
- **10:30 AM** — Stroll through **Kachori & Samosa Lane** – try Kachori Sabzi, ₹30  
- **12:00 PM** — Lunch at **Kashi Chat Bhandar** – Tamatar Chaat, ₹80  
- **01:30 PM** — Auto to **Ramnagar Fort** (5 km, 20 min) – entry ₹30, explore fort & museum  
- **04:00 PM** — Boat ride back across Ganges (₹150 round) to **Assi Ghat** – free, watch locals yoga  
- **06:00 PM** — Return to hotel, rest & freshen up  
- **07:30 PM** — Head to **Dashashwamedh Ghat** for Ganga Aarti (0.5 km, 5 min) – free, best viewed at sunset  
- **08:30 PM** — Dinner at **Deena Chaat Bhandar** – Golgappe, ₹60  
- 💡 *Tip:* Wear comfortable shoes; ghats are slippery early morning.

### Day 3 — Sun, 17 Jan · Sarnath, Market & Return
- **06:30 AM** — Early walk to **Manikarnika Ghat** (0.7 km, 10 min) – free, observe sunrise rituals  
- **08:00 AM** — Breakfast at a **local dhaba near the ghat** – Aloo Paratha, ₹40  
- **09:30 AM** — Check‑out, store luggage at reception, board auto to **Sarnath** (20 km, 45 min) – entry to Dhamek Stupa ₹20, museum ₹20  
- **12:00 PM** — Lunch at **Kachori & Samosa Lane** – Kachori Sabzi, ₹30  
- **01:30 PM** — Return to Varanasi, collect luggage, auto to Varanasi Railway Station (₹80)  
- **09:00 PM** — Board train 13152 JAT KOAA EXPRESS, depart Varanasi  
- **12:00 AM** — Arrive Kolkata, end of trip  
- 💡 *Tip:* Keep your train ticket on your phone; stations can be crowded.

## 🍽️ Food to try
- **Kachori Sabzi** at Kachori & Samosa Lane — ₹30  
- **Tamatar Chaat** at Kashi Chat Bhandar — ₹80  
- **Golgappe** at Deena Chaat Bhandar — ₹60  
- **Banarasi Thali** at Narayan Kothi — ₹150 (optional if time permits)  
- **Aloo Paratha** at local dhaba — ₹40  

## 💰 Budget breakdown
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (train round‑trip) | ₹790 |
| Stay (2 nights) | ₹1,600 |
| Food (3 days × 1 person) | ₹560 |
| Local travel & activities | ₹350 |
| Buffer | ₹890 |
| **Total** | **₹4,190** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing
- Daytime 12‑15 °C, night 8‑10 °C – pack layers, light sweater.  
- Comfortable walking shoes for ghats and alleys.  
- Small scarf or shawl for temple visits and modesty.

## 🏧 Useful nearby
- **ATM:** State Bank of India – near Dashashwamedh Ghat  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil Pump – 4 km from hotel, on NH 19  
- **Hospital:** Banaras Hindu University Hospital – 3 km, +91‑542‑236‑5000  
- **Bus stand / Railway station:** Varanasi Junction (BSB) – main hub  

## 💡 Local tips
- Carry exact change for street vendors; many don’t accept cards.  
- Use prepaid auto‑rickshaws or app‑based rides for safety.  
- Dress modestly at ghats (shoulders covered).  
- No special permits needed for the listed attractions.  
- Keep a copy of your train ticket on phone; stations can be crowded.
